scope: H0/H1 explicit persistent host profile: bounded descriptor fetch, immutable job launch, actual shared-CU/Sv32/AXI integration, memory-engine publication and fault drain. No whole-GPU performance or full milestone closure.

host_contract.discovery: GPU_CAP_PERSISTENT_TILE_JOBS bit 30; the profile clears legacy GPU_CAP_UNIFIED_RENDER and rejects opcode 6 with status 15.
host_contract.submission: Opcode 7, 64-byte-aligned SOURCE VA, exclusive 33-bit descriptor limit from DESTINATION low32/PATTERN bit0, BYTES=256, no DMA/event dependency flags.
host_contract.descriptor: Explicit 64 little-endian words, magic/version 0x47545001, word count 64; all reserved/truncated encodings rejected. Four 64-byte uncached reads before command launch.
host_contract.bindings: Attachment/command bounds, context/pass/generation, viewport, sample/format state and all existing draw defaults. General bounded shader/texture resources remain pending.
host_contract.ownership: Reuse the first host DMA line ID before shader staging; keep descriptor allocation and submitting VM immutable until completion. Offered reads and offered jobs survive backpressure/cancellation until drained.
host_contract.result: Unified command ID identifies the caller-owned immutable record. Internally validate context/pass/generation against the core result. Status 0..6: success/invalid/cancelled/attachment/execution/descriptor-command/texture. Bytes count accepted draw-record reads, excluding descriptor lines.
host_contract.publication: Serialize tile jobs with unified DMA/resolve/invalidate commands in queue order; legacy host-register DMA also waits. A small outstanding memory-owner counter tracks non-kernel work through completion. Unrelated compute stays dispatchable in the same VM.
host_contract.reset: Drain the accepted descriptor/core job and discard the old completion through the existing unified reset protocol.

functional.counting: Final descriptor/host/legacy cohort 36 plus final controller/router cohort 16; the cohorts contain no repeated tests. 52 distinct checks.

native_profiles.backend: actual shared shader CUs, FPU enabled

functional.native_memory: 256-bit AXI, four-bank L2 with 8 sets/two ways, deterministic read delays and 17-cycle write acknowledgements. Bare and Sv32 superpage mapping, descriptor/data/staging/instruction rebinding to +4 MiB.
native_cases_per_profile: two-draw LOAD with depth NEVER and untouched attachments
texture fault on fixed backend / actual shader trap on shared backend
reset during first accepted descriptor read
queued tile + strided DMA + blended LOAD tile
functional.descriptor_matrix: Direct component tests cover four line faults; bounds, exact 4 GiB and wrap rejection; full-field snapshots; reserved/high fields; cancellation before fetch, during an offered read and during an offered job; result backpressure and reuse.
functional.c_abi: sizeof=256 and offsetof for all 37 fields plus reserved tail compile with C11 static assertions; kernel-free driver suite passes.

queued_publication.proof: First DMA source read observes completed tile result; next tile descriptor fetch observes completed DMA result and all copied bytes. Final src-ZERO/dst-ONE blended LOAD preserves the copied image.
queued_publication.performance_scope: Correctness/traffic checks, not a frame-rate, scaling or DRAM performance benchmark.

fault_fix.trigger: Attachment LOAD fault while later command work is queued.
fault_fix.prior_failure: Store fails but command prefetch continues; a queued draw can wait forever on an aborted owner.
fault_fix.change: Qualify the attachment sideband on accepted framebuffer response, cancel prefetch on that fault, and retain status 3 through secondary failures.
fault_fix.observed: Both native backends complete with status 3 and zero attachment exports; descriptor, command, texture and execution faults retain their distinct status and recover.

synthesis.scope: Descriptor reader only; default shader configuration 16 lanes/8 warps, IDs derived from a four-CU shared pool (64 line transactions, reserved ID 32). No CUs/host/renderer/AXI adapter or post-route qualification.

gate.scope: All reported synthesis setup paths, including I/O

mapping.scope: Synthesis mapping report; omitted operators and undriven logic fail qualification

limitations: One resident 8x8/16x16 tile and one RGBA8+D24S8 attachment pair; existing inline triangle records.
Descriptor fetch currently has one outstanding line. A four-ID prefetch window can reduce latency once reordered response, fault and cancellation drain are verified.
Full four-CU/16-lane/eight-warp native validation of this host profile remains required. The earlier real-system TileCommandJob harness covers that profile, but not this descriptor/AXI wrapper.
Command/texture buffering and framebuffer coalescing are rejected until callbacks retain per-response fault ownership.
Coarse memory-engine publication must evolve into scoped dependencies and concurrent transfer progress for multiple tile engines.
Mixed in-pass clear/draw host commands, generalized bounded resources, render-to-texture coverage, queries, driver/Mesa adoption and remaining H0-H8 requirements are pending.
Integrated renderer/GPU physical mapping, clock, 720p frame rates and workload energy remain unqualified.
